question.worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a product $u(x)\cdot v(x)$ with $u(x)={x}^{3}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x).$

Therefore, we apply the product rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x) \\  & ={({x}^{3})}^{′}\cdot \operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x)+{x}^{3}\cdot {[\operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x)]}^{′} \\  & =3{x}^{2}\cdot \operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x)\,+\,{x}^{3}\cdot [-\frac{(2x)^{′}}{2x\sqrt{1-(2x)^{2}}}] \\  & =3{x}^{2}\operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x)+{x}^{3}\cdot (-\frac{2}{2x\sqrt{1-4{x}^{2}}}) \\  & =3{x}^{2}\operatorname{arsech}⁡(2x)-\frac{{x}^{2}}{\sqrt{1-4{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
